description: Org-wide policy for published KMP libraries — automerge baseline, 3-day soak, kotlin-toolchain and first-party holds. See meshtastic/.github:kmp-library.json for the rules and their rationale. kzstd adds the Kotlin Toolchain wrapper, which the preset's Gradle-only hold does not cover.

customManagers.description: The Kotlin Toolchain CLI version pinned in the ./kotlin wrapper. kotlin_cli_sha256 must be updated by hand in the same change.

packageRules.description: HOLD: a Toolchain bump changes the compiler and needs kotlin_cli_sha256 edited by hand, so a human merges it.
